root_cause.text: The `dmirror_fops_release()` function in `lib/test_hmm.c` frees the `dmirror` structure without migrating device private pages back to system memory, leaving those pages with a dangling `zone_device_data` pointer to the freed structure.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies `dmirror_fops_release()` to call `dmirror_device_evict_chunk()` for each devmem chunk before freeing the `dmirror` structure, preventing a use-after-free when `dmirror_devmem_fault()` dereferences the stale `zone_device_data` pointer.

intent_record.intent_summary: Evict all device memory chunks back to system memory during device file release to ensure proper resource cleanup.
intent_record.what: Added the `dmirror_device_evict_chunk` function to migrate device pages back to system memory and integrated it into `dmirror_fops_release` to iterate through and evict all device memory chunks.
intent_record.how: Ensures that when the dmirror device file is closed, all allocated device-private and device-coherent memory chunks are safely migrated back to system memory, preventing memory leaks and dangling page references.

bic_trace_step.reason: The `dmirror_fops_release` function (lines 148-156) removes the notifier, destroys the xarray, and frees the `dmirror` structure using `kfree(dmirror)` without migrating device private pages back to system memory. This leaves the `zone_device_data` pointer of the allocated pages (set in `dmirror_migrate_alloc_and_copy` at line 520 as `rpage->zone_device_data = dmirror`) pointing to the freed `dmirror` structure, leading to a use-after-free in `dmirror_devmem_fault` (lines 841-842).
